decisions.reason: The candidate already records the dates under the combined FCC_FH identifier, and the clarification that FCC and FH are the same school does not change any service-period date.
The FCC/FH identifier clarification does not change the existing requirement to place signatures in the subcontractor section.
The candidate already records the $9,990 allocation under the combined fcc_fh_allocated_budget key, so the clarification introduces no additional budget update or obsolete key.
The candidate's calculation rules and current site-specific values concern Queens Collegiate and JHS 157; identifying FCC and FH as the same school does not necessarily alter those rules or values.
